channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Fears over speeding motorists on road set for more than a hundred homes
item.description: People living near land set for more than a hundred homes fear the number of drivers who speed down Green Lane West in Rackheath will only increase.

item.title: Neighbours disturbed for hours due to farm shop owners' noisy tractor
item.description: Neighbours in Norwich Road have complained after maintenance works carried out by Trevor Thain caused their homes to shake for hours on end.

item.title: Suspect who pushed over vulnerable man remains at large
item.description: Detectives have closed an investigation after a vulnerable man was shoved to the ground at a bus stop in Edward Street.

item.title: MPs warn changes to shotgun laws are 'attack' on Norfolk way of life
item.description: Norfolk MPs have warned that potential government changes to shotgun licensing risk damaging the rural way of life and the county's economy.

item.title: Army officer to stand trial accused of sex assault at Norfolk club
item.description: An officer in the British Army is to stand trial accused of sexual assaulting a woman at a Norfolk nightclub.

item.title: College manager hacked computers after being caught selling stolen items on eBay
item.description: Jonny Crabb was discovered to be stealing computer equipment while assistant resources manager at Access Creative College in Norwich.

item.title: Tributes paid to one of town's 'great characters' who has died aged 96
item.description: A man described as one of the last great characters of Cobholm in Great Yarmouth has died at the age of 96.

item.title: Bid to convert redundant barn into new therapy room in Norfolk village
item.description: A proposal has been submitted to North Norfolk District Council (NNDC) to convert a barn off Happisburgh Road in East Ruston into a therapy room.

item.title: Three Norfolk pubs 'delighted' to take home top awards
item.description: The Blue Bell in Stoke Ferry has been named West Norfolk CAMRA's Pub of the Year, with The Live and Let Live and Ferry Lane Social Club also taking home awards.

item.title: Storytelling can help encourage conversation around mental health
item.description: Robin Windsor was a dazzlingly talented dancer and choreographer from our region, having been born and brought up in Ipswich, who was perhaps best known for his role on Strictly Come Dancing.
